spiritual_warfare: Armor up and hold the line. Replace lies with truth; speak Scripture out loud.
You’re not outgunned—you’re outfitted. Call for backup and stand firm.
forgiveness: Confession clears comms; forgiveness removes enemy footholds.
Release them into God’s hands; travel light to move fast.
guidance: You don’t need the whole map—just the next waypoint.
Seek counsel, pray, then move the ball downfield.

spiritual_warfare.txt: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil.

forgiveness.txt: Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ forgave you.

guidance.txt: Trust in the LORD with all your heart... he will make straight your paths.

prayers: Lord of Hosts, strengthen me to pray first, hear Your voice, and obey quickly. Guard my mind and steady my steps. Amen.
